crew_voice_announce_background: Screen reader announcement when the window lost the foreground while recording.
crew_voice_announce_cancelled: Screen reader announcement when dictation was cancelled with Escape.
crew_voice_announce_cap: Screen reader announcement when the recording reached the maximum length; {minutes} is a number.
crew_voice_announce_device_lost: Screen reader announcement when the input device disappeared while recording.
crew_voice_announce_inserted: Screen reader announcement after the transcript was put into the message box.
crew_voice_announce_restored: Screen reader announcement after Escape took the dictated text back out.
crew_voice_announce_started: Screen reader announcement when the microphone starts recording.
crew_voice_announce_stopped: Screen reader announcement when the person stops the recording.
crew_voice_busy: Shown when a second recording was requested while one is live.
crew_voice_denied: Shown when the system refuses the microphone to Atlas; a button opens the system page.
crew_voice_dictate: Accessible name and tooltip of the microphone button of the message box (idle).
crew_voice_dictate_tip: Tooltip of the microphone button; {shortcut} is the key chord, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+M.
crew_voice_dismiss: Accessible name of the close button of the dictation error.
crew_voice_empty: Shown when the engine returned an empty text.
crew_voice_engine: Names the speech engine of the crew server while dictating; {engine} is its label, e.g. whisper.cpp (small).
crew_voice_failed: Shown when the audio device failed to open; {detail} is the system's own words.
crew_voice_hint_hold: Hint under the live indicator when the microphone key is hold-to-talk.
crew_voice_hint_tap: Hint under the live indicator when the microphone key is press-to-start, press-to-stop.
crew_voice_key: Label of the setting that says how the message box microphone works.
crew_voice_key_hint: Description of the microphone key setting; {shortcut} is the key chord.
crew_voice_key_hold: Option: record while the key or button is held down.
crew_voice_key_tap: Option: one press starts the recording and the next one stops it.
crew_voice_mic_live: Indicator shown the whole time the microphone is recording.
crew_voice_no_device: Shown when the system has no input device.
crew_voice_settings_status: Label of the row that shows one crew server's speech engine and state.
crew_voice_settings_status_hint: Description of the voice status row in Settings > Atlas Crew.
crew_voice_settings_title: Title of the Dictation group in Settings > Atlas Crew.
crew_voice_starting: Shown while the microphone is being opened (the first time the system asks for permission).
crew_voice_status_checking: Voice status while the crew server has not answered yet.
crew_voice_status_not_installed: Voice status when the crew server has no speech engine.
crew_voice_status_not_ready: Voice status: the speech engine is configured but cannot run right now; {engine} is its label.
crew_voice_status_off: Voice status when the owner turned dictation off for the whole crew.
crew_voice_status_ready: Voice status: the speech engine is installed and runs; {engine} is its label.
crew_voice_status_unsupported: Voice status of a crew server that predates dictation.
crew_voice_stop: Accessible name of the microphone button while it is recording.
crew_voice_switch: Label of the owner's switch that turns dictation on or off for the whole crew server.
crew_voice_switch_hint: Description of the crew-wide dictation switch.
crew_voice_transcribing: Shown while the crew server turns the recording into text.
crew_voice_unavailable: Shown in an agent instance, which never raises the system microphone prompt.
crew_voice_unsupported: Accessible name and tooltip of the disabled microphone when the crew server predates dictation.
